cells.quote: Data in Table 3 show that there was a significant difference between the attitudes mean scores of students taught using gardening toward entrepreneurial skills acquisition (X‒=1.47, SD=9.47) and those not taught with that method (X ‒=1.24, SD=6.86, t0.031, p≤0.05).
cells.note: The experimental group was exposed to gardening for 6 weeks and the control group was taught the same concepts for the same period without exposure to gardening. Two intact classes were used; assignment to conditions was non-randomized.

cells.quote: Result in Table 4 shows no significant difference between the attitudes mean scores of males (X‒=1.41, SD=0.50) and females (X‒=1.31, SD=0.47, t 0.409, p≥0.05) taught using gardening, toward entrepreneurial skills acquisition.
cells.note: The study reports no significant gender difference, but no equivalence test or adequate-power analysis is reported; therefore the direction is coded ns rather than 0.
